EchoPods does not collect, store, sell, or share personal information for advertising, analytics, tracking, or profiling. The app does not include analytics, advertising SDKs, or tracking services.

Bluetooth observations and app settings are processed on your device. The app contacts GitHub to check for releases and download an update when one is available. GitHub may receive normal request metadata such as your network address and app version.
The app links to the EchoPods GitHub repository for source code and issue reports. It does not send diagnostics or device information automatically.

If you choose to create an issue from the app, your browser opens GitHub with the title and details you entered, plus the app version and device model for troubleshooting. Nothing is submitted until you review and submit it on GitHub.
You can edit or remove any pre-filled information before submitting the issue.
The app provides a link to the public EchoPods GitHub repository. Opening it is optional and subject to the GitHub privacy policy.
When opening a GitHub issue from EchoPods, the app may pre-fill:
• EchoPods version name and version code
This information is only sent to GitHub if you review and submit the issue.
All EchoPods app features are available without payment or a subscription. The app does not process payments or collect billing information.
For questions or privacy requests, open an issue at github.com/blossom0948/EchoPods.
